headline: Analog Devices authors report UVM regression for SV-RNM model-to-netlist validation
fact: An Analog Devices-authored paper reports a block-level UVM constrained-random testbench run against both an SV-RNM behavioral model and the analog netlist. The same stimuli and checks provide one-to-one comparison, the tests can run in regular or nightly regressions, and the paper describes reusing the block-level agents in system-level verification.

sources.title: UVM Based Approach To Model Validation For SV-RNM Behavioral Models
sources.summary: 2016 Analog Devices paper on shared-stimulus UVM regression against SV-RNM models and analog netlists.
